    },
    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.settings-group-types",

      "projects": [
        "chromium"
      ],
      "timeout_seconds": 1800
    },
    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.membership-catalog-settings",

      ],

    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.iphone-settings",
      "area": "frontend",
      "working_directory": "frontend",
      "command": [
        "npm",
        "run",
        "test:e2e",
        "--",
        "e2e/iphone-target-devices.spec.ts",
        "--project=iphone-air-webkit",
        "--project=iphone-17-pro-max-webkit",
        "--grep",
        "TASK-161|админ-панель|каталог абонементов|филиалы и залы"
      ],
      "timeout_seconds": 1800
    },
    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.stage12-settings",
      "area": "frontend",
      "working_directory": "frontend",
      "command": [
        "npm",
        "run",
        "test:e2e",
        "--",
        "e2e/stage12.spec.ts",
        "--project=chromium",
        "--grep",
        "Настройки позволяют"

      "timeout_seconds": 1800

    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.responsive-main-screens-settings",
      "area": "frontend",
      "working_directory": "frontend",
      "command": [
        "npm",
        "run",
        "test:e2e",
        "--",
        "e2e/responsive-main-screens.spec.ts",
        "--project=chromium",
        "--grep",
        "Settings branches"
      ],
      "timeout_seconds": 1800
    },
    {
      "id": "frontend.e2e.touch-target-inventory-settings",
      "area": "frontend",
      "working_directory": "frontend",
      "command": [
        "npm",
        "run",
        "test:e2e",
        "--",
        "e2e/touch-target-inventory.spec.ts",
        "--project=chromium",
        "--grep",
        "checks representative routes"
      ],
      "timeout_seconds": 1800
    }
  ],
  "manual_evidence": "backlog/implementation/TASK-190-manual-evidence.json",
  "manual_checks": [
    {
      "id": "manual.rendered-comparison",
      "description": "Compare rendered HeadCoach controls and SuperAdministrator branch/hall forms with approved baseline at mobile, desktop and compact height; verify modal feedback/focus. Report device-only limits separately."
    }
  ]
}
